goal.objective: On an admitted canonical publisher-artifact-transfer event, verify exact queued transfer bytes, render only through merged Publisher destination semantics, construct canonical forward InTr receipts, and stage the canonical response packet plus first return hop for device-to-KV completion.
success_predicates: publisher-artifact-transfer materialization request and exact payload ingress are independently admitted
exact payload bytes match the canonical transport intent hash and Publisher transfer schema
existing Publisher rendering source produces GENERATED_VALIDATED_NOT_PUBLISHED
forward Universal InTr receipt chain validates complete
CanonicalInTrConnector.prepare_response constructs the reverse intent with forward terminal receipt lineage
first response hop is staged for the originating device and the KV terminal hop remains separately unclaimed
no publication, release, execution, credential, or GitHub runtime authority is created
failure_predicates: materialization request alone is treated as proof exact payload bytes arrived
consumer or ingress mints WorkerCoordinator claim/fence
Publisher rendering bypasses its merged document pipeline
return-to-KV is claimed before the terminal KV hop receipt exists
GitHub token or non-TV/TVC credential is required

authority.authority_source: StegVerse-Labs/.github#582; destination operation additionally bounded by owner-authorized Publisher transfer payload

terminal_when: exact Publisher transfer bytes are ingress-materialized
canonical response intent and first return hop are staged
terminal KV return hop remains separately pending
completion.next_authorized_action: On the next exact publisher-artifact-transfer Universal InTr event, shared profiled ingress must persist and hash-verify the transfer bytes, then invoke the non-authorizing materialization consumer; WorkerCoordinator independently claims the existing Publisher transfer task, which may stage only the canonical response through the first return hop while terminal KV import remains separate.
